summary: Owns Prometheus metrics for data stream destination counts and payload sizes.
responsibilities: Normalize stream type and MIME type labels.
Record destination count and optional total payload size.

summary: Prometheus data stream labels and histograms.

variables.summary: Label names used for data packet stream metrics.
Allowed top-level MIME type labels for data packet stream metrics.
Records data stream destination counts by stream type and MIME type.
Records data stream payload sizes by stream type and MIME type.

summary: Initializes and registers data packet stream Prometheus histograms.
summary_step: 1. Creates destination count and byte-size histograms with node id and node type labels.
2. Uses stream type and MIME type labels for both metric families.
3. Registers the histograms with the default Prometheus registry.

summary: Records data stream destination count and optional payload size using normalized stream and MIME labels.
summary_step: 1. Derives the stream type label from the data stream content header kind.
2. Normalizes the MIME type to its top-level category and falls back to unknown when unsupported.
3. Observes destination count and total payload length when the header carries a total length.
